description: NHC 5-day forecast cone of uncertainty for Hurricane Melissa (AL132025), one polygon per advisory, all 80 advisories stacked (21-31 October 2025). Rows carry the NHC attributes plus derived advisory_number, advisory_seq and issue_time (UTC). The cone is the probable track of the storm centre, not the extent of hazardous winds.

table:columns.name: advisory_number
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): zero-padded advisory id from the NHC package name, e.g. '003A'; sorts in issue order as text. Join key across forecast/cone, forecast/track, forecast/points, forecast/watches-warnings and forecast/wind-radii.

table:columns.name: advisory_seq
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): 1-based issue order of the advisory (001 = 1, 001A = 2, ..., 041 = 80).

table:columns.name: STORMNAME
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The name given to each tropical cyclone for which the National Hurricane Center is writing forecast advisories'. 'Melissa' in this file.

table:columns.name: STORMTYPE
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The category of the tropical cyclone according to the initial intensity'. TS Tropical Storm (33 rows), HU Hurricane (46), PTC Post-tropical Cyclone (1, advisory 041; a code absent from NHC's list, meaning taken from the TCDVLP text of forecast/points).

table:columns.name: ADVDATE
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The date in which an advisory is issued'. Free text in the advisory's local time zone, e.g. '1100 AM EDT Tue Oct 21 2025'. Parsed into issue_time; do not string-compare.

table:columns.name: ADVISNUM
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The sequential numbering of forecast advisories for each tropical cyclone'. Not zero-padded ('1', '1A', ..., '41'); sort/join on advisory_number instead.

table:columns.name: STORMNUM
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The sequential numbering of tropical cyclones for a specific forecast basin according to when the first advisory is issued' (13 = Melissa, AL132025).

table:columns.name: FCSTPRD
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The time interval for which the forecast of a tropical cyclone is provided in graphical format' (hours); always 120 here.

table:columns.name: BASIN
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The ocean where the tropical cyclone is located'; AL = Atlantic.

table:columns.name: issue_time
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): advisory issue time in UTC parsed from ADVDATE; local zone abbreviations mapped to fixed offsets (EDT and AST = UTC-4). 2025-10-21 15:00 to 2025-10-31 15:00 UTC, strictly increasing with advisory_seq. Use for 'latest advisory known at time T'.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Cone polygon (1,360 to 2,334 vertices, all valid) in lon/lat WGS 84 (typed OGC:CRS84 in the hosted file). NHC ships the shapefiles with an authalic-sphere GCS in the .prj; coordinates were not transformed.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: GeoParquet bounding-box covering column (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) written for predicate pushdown; not an NHC attribute.
